name: Hotel Marques de Riscal
positioning: Hotel Marqués de Riscal, a Luxury Collection Hotel: a Frank O. Gehry-designed hotel with titanium ribbons, set in the Marqués de Riscal City of Wine in Elciego, Rioja Alavesa
best_for: Architecture fans drawn to Frank O. Gehry's design
Wine lovers who want a stay on a historic winery estate with daily cellar tours

facts.text: The hotel is in the Marqués de Riscal City of Wine, in the medieval town of Elciego in Rioja Alavesa.
The hotel was designed by architect Frank O. Gehry.
Its avant-garde design is characterized by flowing lines and titanium ribbons.
The main building has a red-, silver- and gold-metal ribbon roof.
Marqués de Riscal winery, founded in 1858, is the oldest winery in the region.
Daily winery tours lead from fermenting rooms to oak-barrel aging rooms and a cellar housing eight million bottles of wine.
The 'Cathedral' bottle cellar holds bottles from nearly every vintage since the winery's founding.
Rooms and suites have views of the countryside, the medieval town of Elciego or the hotel's architecture.
Rooms feature bedside cloud lamps made of white fabric balloons and green and black Italian marble baths.
Every room and suite greets guests with a complimentary bottle of Rioja wine.

At the Vinothérapie Spa Caudalie, vinotherapy specialists trained in the Bordeaux wine region use treatments based on the essence of the grape, and a Barrel Bath lets guests soak in a bubbly mix of grape pomace.
1860 Tradición is an airy second-floor restaurant with panoramic views of the vineyards and Elciego.

highlights.text: Gehry took on the challenge of designing a hotel in the heart of a wine cellar, something he had never done before.
The Gehry Suite is a loft-like suite in the Gehry Wing with a private terrace.
The spa journey runs from a heated indoor pool with water jets to a hammam, a Finnish sauna and a rainforest shower, with views of the estate's vineyards.
The top-floor Library has a large outdoor terrace suspended among the titanium waves on the building's exterior.
Guests can explore the surroundings on the hotel's complimentary bicycles (subject to availability).

considerations.text: Most guest rooms are in a spa annex built into a hill, reached by a glass-enclosed bridge, rather than in the Gehry main building.
Rooms do not have a fridge.
WhataHotel notes a remote location in Rioja wine country that requires transportation.
